blocks.en: This page serves as a central hub for information related to Player versus Player (PvP) combat in EVE Online. PvP is a core element of the game and can occur in all areas of space. This page provides an overview of the different types of PvP, key mechanics, and relevant tools and resources for further learning.
blocks.zh: 本页是 EVE Online 玩家对战（PvP）相关信息的汇总入口。PvP 是游戏的核心要素之一，在宇宙的任何区域都可能发生。本页概述了 PvP 的不同类型、关键机制，以及可供进一步学习的相关工具和资源。

blocks.en: PvP in EVE Online refers to combat between player-controlled ships. It can take many forms, from small individual encounters to large-scale battles involving hundreds of pilots. Engagements may be consensual, such as arranged duels or tournament fights, or non-consensual, such as ambushes or ganks. Unlike in many MMOs, ship loss in EVE Online is permanent, making PvP encounters significant and often high-risk.
blocks.zh: EVE Online 中的 PvP 指玩家操控的舰船之间的战斗。它的形式多种多样，从小规模的单挑遭遇到数百名飞行员参与的大规模会战都有。交战可以是双方自愿的，例如约定的决斗或锦标赛对决；也可以是非自愿的，例如伏击或自杀式攻击。与许多 MMO 不同，EVE Online 中损失的舰船是永久失去的，因此每一次 PvP 遭遇都意义重大，而且往往风险很高。

blocks.en: PvP in EVE Online can be broadly categorised into several formats:
blocks.zh: EVE Online 中的 PvP 大致可以分为以下几种形式：

en: Solo – Independent engagements without support, relying on individual decision-making and ship control.
Small Gang – Fights involving small, coordinated groups, often focused on hit-and-run tactics or skirmishes.
Fleet – Large, structured battles using predefined doctrines and assigned roles.
Faction Warfare – Conflict centred around low security space objectives in the Factional Warfare system.
Wormhole – Combat in wormhole space, often involving surprise engagements and evictions.
Highsec – Includes duels, war declarations, and illegal combat actions such as ganking.
Public fleets – Public fleets that allow participation from anyone outside the organiser’s direct alliance or corporation.
Nullsec – Includes sovereignty warfare, entosis mechanics, and large-scale territorial engagements.
Structure Warfare – Fights centred around attacking or defending Upwell structures or other deployables.
zh: 单人 – 没有支援的独立作战，依靠个人的判断和操船技术。
小队 – 小型协同团体之间的战斗，通常以打了就跑或小规模遭遇战为主。
舰队 – 使用预先制定的配置方案（doctrine）和分配好职责的大型有组织会战。
势力战争 – 围绕势力战争体系中低安空间目标展开的冲突。
虫洞 – 在虫洞空间中的战斗，经常涉及突袭和驱逐战。
高安 – 包括决斗、宣战，以及自杀式攻击等非法战斗行为。
公开舰队 – 允许组织者所在联盟或军团以外的任何人参与的公开舰队。
00 区 – 包括主权战争、熵变（entosis）机制和大规模领土争夺战。
建筑战 – 围绕攻击或防守昇威建筑或其他可部署建筑展开的战斗。

blocks.en: Players new to PvP may wish to begin with small-scale engagements to develop core skills. It is recommended to:
blocks.zh: 刚接触 PvP 的玩家可以先从小规模交战开始，以锻炼核心技能。建议：

en: Train essential fitting, navigation, and combat-related skills
Use inexpensive ships such as frigates for initial practice
Review ship loss mechanics and killmail systems
Learn the basics of scanning, tackling, and brawling or kiting
Practice using overview settings and manual piloting techniques
zh: 训练必要的装配、导航和战斗相关技能
使用护卫舰等廉价舰船进行初期练习
了解舰船损失机制和击毁报告系统
学习扫描、拦截以及近战或风筝的基础
练习使用总览设置和手动操船技巧

blocks.en: Key skill areas that improve PvP performance include:
blocks.zh: 能够提升 PvP 表现的关键技能领域包括：

en: Navigation and propulsion
Capacitor and tanking systems (shield, armor, hull)
Weapon systems (turrets, missiles, drones)
Electronic warfare and sensor management
Core fitting skills (see Magic 14)
Role-specific skills for tackle, logistics, and command functions
zh: 导航与推进
电容与坦克系统（护盾、装甲、结构）
武器系统（炮台、导弹、无人机）
电子战与感应器管理
核心装配技能（参见 Magic 14）
拦截、后勤和指挥等职能的专属技能

blocks.en: Skill progression in EVE Online is time-based; however, even new characters can contribute meaningfully in combat with appropriate fits and roles.
blocks.zh: EVE Online 的技能成长基于时间；不过，只要装配和定位合适，即使是新角色也能在战斗中做出有意义的贡献。

blocks.en: PvP opportunities exist in all areas of space:
blocks.zh: 宇宙的各个区域都存在 PvP 机会：

en: High Security Space – Duels, war declarations, ganking
Low Security Space – Gatecamps, Faction Warfare, piracy
Null Security Space – Roams, structure fights, sovereignty warfare
Wormhole Space – Surprise attacks, evictions, rolling battles
Public (NPSI) Fleets – Organized through Discord, forums, or public calendars
ESS Raids and Filaments – Provide access to remote and active PvP zones
zh: 高安空间 – 决斗、宣战、自杀式攻击
低安空间 – 堵门（gatecamp）、势力战争、海盗行为
00 区空间 – 游荡（roam）、建筑战、主权战争
虫洞空间 – 突袭、驱逐战、滚洞（rolling）战斗
公开（NPSI）舰队 – 通过 Discord、论坛或公开日程表组织
ESS 突袭与纤维 – 前往偏远且活跃的 PvP 区域的途径

blocks.en: The following tools are commonly used by PvP participants:
blocks.zh: PvP 玩家常用以下工具：

en: zKillboard – Killmail database and performance analysis
DOTLAN Maps – Map tool showing activity and geography
NPSI.Rocks – Public fleet calendar and NPSI community resources
PYFA – Standalone ship fitting tool
zh: zKillboard – 击毁报告数据库和战绩分析
DOTLAN Maps – 显示活跃度和地理信息的地图工具
NPSI.Rocks – 公开舰队日程表和 NPSI 社区资源
PYFA – 独立的舰船装配工具
